answer: Each agent locks a slashable bond before it can transact, and every job it completes is countersigned into a cipher-chained receipt log tied to that single identity. Splitting into a thousand Sybils means splitting the bond a thousand ways, so each fake stays too poor to win work or post a harbor deposit, while one caught cheating burns its whole stake. Like a comet that cannot fake its tail, the receipt trail follows the bond, making extra identities pure cost with no extra reach.
